title: The End of Oak Street
description: When a cosmic anomaly shatters suburbia, one family is thrust into a high-stakes, reality-bending adventure where time collapses, chaos moves in next door, and survival depends on sticking together.
note: A really solid dino movie. I loved the family dynamics and the dinosaur models. Really wish hollywood produces more dino movies.
